snapshot.name: Navin Fluorine International Ltd
snapshot.about: Navin Fluorine International Ltd is primary engaged in producing refrigeration gases, inorganic fluorides, specialty organofluorines and offers contract research and manufacturing services. [1] Its portfolio includes 50+ fluorinated compounds developed over the years. [2]

latest_quarter.source: screener quarterly table (standardised from exchange filing)
latest_quarter.headline: Revenue +57% YoY, EBITDA +65%, PAT +82%, margin 34.2% (+1.7pp YoY)

notes.text: Growth is slowing: revenue CAGR 23% over 5y → 17% over 3y
Margins expanding: OPM 33% vs 24% avg of prior years
Working capital tightening: cash conversion cycle 119 → 60 days
5-yr cumulative CFO is 1.20× PAT (₹2,226 Cr vs ₹1,861 Cr)
5-yr free cash flow ₹-840 Cr; negative in 2 of 5 years

business_mix.what_it_does: Navin Fluorine International Limited engages in the manufacturing and development of fluorine-based chemicals across business segments including High Performance Products (HPP), Specialty Chemicals, and Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.

segments.name: HPP (High Performance Products)
segments.note: Includes refrigerant gases, AHF, and HFO products.

segments.name: Specialty Chemicals
segments.note: Focuses on differentiated chemistries and customized molecules.

segments.name: CDMO
segments.note: Contract development and manufacturing for global innovators in therapeutic areas.

business_mix.source: Navin Fluorine International Ltd Q2 and H1 FY27 Earnings Conference Call Transcript

guidance.statement: CDMO order book visibility is nearing the USD100 million target.
guidance.quote: we are at the striking distance of our USD100 million target in terms of order book visibility.
guidance.speaker: Anish Ganatra

guidance.statement: cGMP-4 Phase 1 and Phase 2 peak annual revenue potential is INR900 crores to INR1,000 crores by FY28, FY29.
guidance.quote: cGMP-4 Phase 2, when Phase 1 and Phase 2 put together, the peak annual revenue potential is close to 3x of the capital or about INR900 crores to INR1,000 crores by FY28, FY29
guidance.speaker: Anish Ganatra

guidance.statement: Annual capex frame will range between INR700 crores and INR1,000 crores.
guidance.quote: our capex frame will be in the INR700 crores to INR1,000 crores every year.
guidance.speaker: Anish Ganatra

guidance.statement: FY27 margins are expected to be in the same range as the first half.
guidance.quote: For this year itself, for FY27, just to be clear, we are going to be working on the margins that you see for the first half in the same sort of range for the year.
guidance.speaker: Anish Ganatra

guidance.statement: Advanced Materials will comprise 10% to 15% of the expanded pie by 2030, with growth between now and 2030 at 20% to 25%.
guidance.quote: if you think of Navin from now to 2030 and look at 20% to 25% growth, Advanced Materials will be roughly about 10% to 15% of the expanded pie by 2030.
guidance.speaker: Anish Ganatra

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin will be in the range of 32% to 33%, plus or minus 1%.
guidance.quote: what we are talking about wi ll be in the range of that 32%, 33%, plus/minus 1% here or there.
guidance.speaker: Anish Ganatra

guidance.statement: Adding 15,000 tons of capacity to the existing 9,000 to 10,000 tons.
guidance.quote: I currently have a 9,000 to 10,000 ton s of capacity, and I'm adding in 15,000 tons of capacity.
guidance.speaker: Anish Ganatra

guidance.statement: Net working capital is expected to be in the range of 75 to 80 days.
guidance.quote: net working capital is expected to be in the range of 75 to 80 days versus our previous indicative guidance of 90 days of sales
guidance.speaker: Anish Ganatra

guidance.statement: Employee cost should be modeled in the range of 7.5%, 8.5%, 9%, not more than that.
guidance.quote: I would model it in the range of between 7.5%, 8.5%, 9%, not more than that.
guidance.speaker: Anish Ganatra

guidance.statement: Dedicated fluorochemical plant capacity utilization will be around 50% to 60% this year, going to 70% to 75% in the coming year.
guidance.quote: our endeavor would be to be around 50%, 60% capacity utilization this year. That would go to about 70%, 75% in the coming year.
guidance.speaker: Anish Ganatra

guidance.statement: Realistically talking about 75% to 80% capacity utilization by end of FY28.
guidance.quote: realistically talking about 75% to 80% is where we will get to by end of FY28.
guidance.speaker: Anish Ganatra

guidance.statement: Endeavor to do 30% EBITDA margin, plus or minus 1% to 2% on a full year basis.
guidance.quote: we will endeavor to do 30%. Given what we know today of the business circumstances, plus/minus 1% to 2%
guidance.speaker: Anish Ganatra

guidance.statement: Annualized EBITDA margins are expected to be around 30% plus or minus 200 basis points.
guidance.quote: annualized number that we are looking at 30% give or take plus/minus 200 basis points
guidance.speaker: Anish Ganatra

guidance.statement: We are well on track to achieve an EBITDA margin between 28% to 30% for the full year.
guidance.quote: we are well on track to be between 28% to 30% for the year.
guidance.speaker: Anish Ganatra

guidance.statement: Cash outflow for capex will be within INR600 crores to INR700 crores for the year.
guidance.quote: It will be within the range of that INR700 crores -- INR600 crores, INR700 crores for the year in terms of cash outflow
guidance.speaker: Anish Ganatra

guidance.statement: Total capex frame for the next couple of years is about INR1,000 crores.
guidance.quote: the frame remains for the next couple of years to about INR1,000 crores.
guidance.speaker: Anish Ganatra

narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Management consistently guided for stable margins around 28% to 33%.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Actual OPM expanded steadily from 21% in Sep 2024 to 34% by Dec 2025 and stayed there through Sep 2026.

promises.credibility: Management has shown strong credibility on margin delivery, regularly beating conservative guidance as operating profitability expanded.

bull: Latest quarter Sep 2026 shows strong growth with Revenue up 57% YoY, EBITDA +65%, and PAT +82%.
Debt to Equity improved significantly to 0.28, down from 0.57 three periods ago, with investments of ₹1,278 Cr exceeding borrowings of ₹1,248 Cr.
Working capital has tightened effectively, reducing the cash conversion cycle from 119 to 60 days.
bear: Growth is visibly slowing, as the revenue CAGR dropped from 23% over 5 years down to 17% over 3 years.
Free cash flow over 5 years is negative at ₹-840 Cr, remaining negative in 2 out of the 5 years.
CDMO order book visibility targeting USD100 million by FY27 remains pending completion of the target horizon period.
